headline: Shanghai Masters: Zverev beats Bublik 7-6 (6), 4-6, 7-6 (1)
whyCareReason: The top seed and year-end No. 1 came through a three-set round of 16. De Minaur, Gea and Davidovich Fokina also won.
teaser: ATP time: 2:37:48. The quarter-final line from Tuesday is Zverev against de Minaur, and Gea against Davidovich Fokina.
story: Alexander Zverev beat Alexander Bublik 7-6 (6), 4-6, 7-6 (1) in the Shanghai round of 16. The ATP lists the match at 2:37:48. Alex de Minaur beat Karen Khachanov 6-3, 6-4 in 1:25:31. Arthur Gea beat Jakub Mensik 7-6 (4), 6-4 in 1:37:01. Alejandro Davidovich Fokina beat Hubert Hurkacz 1-6, 6-3, 7-6 (6) in 2:04:01. Four round-of-16 matches remain, including Tommy Paul against Zizou Bergs. Jannik Sinner is still out for the season.
stakes: Zverev's quarter-final is against de Minaur. Gea plays Davidovich Fokina. The other half of the round of 16 is still to be played.
rivalryAngle: The year-end No. 1 had to go three sets against the 19th seed on Stadium Court.
funFacts: de Minaur (9) d. Khachanov (26): 6-3, 6-4. Gea d. Mensik (13): 7-6 (4), 6-4. Davidovich Fokina (25) d. Hurkacz: 1-6, 6-3, 7-6 (6).
Still to play: van de Zandschulp vs Jodar, Ruud vs Auger-Aliassime, Medvedev vs Tsitsipas, Paul vs Bergs.
